newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 30.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:
* President Bill Clinton accepts Democratic Party nomination for a second term, says "hope is back."
* Clinton campaign adviser Dick Morris quits over his relationship with a prostitute.
* Morris affair was not what Clinton needed.
* Rebels strike in four Mexican states, leaving 13 dead.
* Palestinians stage general strike and Israel hears the message.
* Computer simulation puts blast aboard TWA Flight 800 in a small area, offers hints of bombing.
* Federal authorities permit ValuJet Airlines to fly again.
